name: Cutlass
description: Short, heavy and curved. It has settled more arguments than the ship's articles.

name: Boarding Axe
description: For cutting rigging, doors and opinions. Heavier than the cutlass.

name: Captain's Coat
description: Crimson wool and gold braid, with enough pockets to lose a pistol in.

name: Oilskin Jacket
description: Waxed canvas that sheds spray and splinters. Smells faintly of fish.

name: Sea Boots
description: Tall black boots with soles that grip a wet deck.

name: Lucky Doubloon
description: The first coin you ever took. You have never spent it and never will.

name: Rat-Catcher's Charm
description: A string of rat teeth. Quill insists it is a trophy, not a souvenir.

name: Fishbone Charm
description: Old Finch swears it has kept him from drowning for forty years.
